speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
text: asked	the Prime Minister (a) whether any Government studies have been undertaken on the feasibility of online voting for overseas Singaporeans using SingPass which can overcome security and secrecy concerns relating to postal voting; (b) if so, whether they can be made available; and (c) if such studies do not exist, whether the Government can share with Singaporeans the obstacles preventing these studies from being undertaken.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: The Minister mentioned that the use of SingPass may solve some of the issues, but what are they?

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Perhaps, he could elaborate a little bit about what are the other issues that SingPass may not be able to solve.

speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
text: SingPass, as of now, we have a single- and a double-authentication method.

speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
text: Both of these are contingent on us being able to verify that the person is, indeed, the person using the token and the SingPass password.

speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
text: For any Internet banking transaction equivalent, we also have the same challenge.

speaker: Mdm Speaker
